name: Send SMS
description: Send a single outbound SMS text message to one phone number (E.164 format). Pay-per-message via x402 (USDC on Base or Solana). One operation served via multiple gateways: Textbelt (real delivery), Spraay (sandbox/mock), and a Twilio REST proxy (needs own Twilio key).

quirks: Phone must be E.164 format (e.g. +15555550123).
FIELD-NAME TRAP: the three gateways use DIFFERENT field names — Textbelt {phone, message}, Spraay {to, body}, Twilio {To, From, Body}. Do not assume a single shape.
Spraay backend is a SANDBOX/MOCK: returns 200 + status:queued but _gateway.live=false and note 'SMS queued. Production integrates with Twilio/Vonage' -> NO real delivery despite the 200.

httpay/Twilio backend's registry URL is a broken literal '{*path}' path-template; real endpoint is /twilio/Messages.json and it requires a user-supplied Twilio account credential (not keyless) — recommend dropping it.
All backends pay $0.02 USDC (gateway fee) except httpay which is $0.002; Base eip155:8453 and Solana both accepted on Spraay/Textbelt.
Synchronous response; for Textbelt, poll GET .../status/{textId} for delivery state. Spraay has no poll URL (queued is final).
DELIVERY CONFIRMED 2026-06-11: real SMS received via Textbelt/paysponge ($0.02, 200). Field names {phone, message} confirmed.
The spraay.app backend is a MOCK (does not actually send) — use the paysponge/Textbelt backend.

Synchronous: returns {success:true, quotaRemaining} immediately. ⚠ success=ACCEPTED, not delivered: a 2026-06-23 test to a Canadian (+1 236) number returned success but did NOT arrive (Textbelt region/sandbox limitation; no textId returned by the gateway to check delivery status). Treat as best-effort; verify US delivery. Outward → needsApproval gated.
usage.guide: Send a single outbound SMS text message to one phone number (E.164 format). Pay-per-message via x402 (USDC on Base or Solana). One operation served via multiple gateways: Textbelt (real delivery), Spraay (sandbox/mock), and a Twilio REST proxy (needs own Twilio key). POST to the chosen gateway with a JSON body. Default (Textbelt via paysponge): body {phone, message} (field names UNVERIFIED via proxy). Spraay (mock): body {to, body}. Pay the x402 fee (USDC on Base or Solana). Output: Spraay (verified-shape, mock): { id, status } where status='queued'. Textbelt native: { success, textId, quotaRemaining } (textId used to poll .../status/{textId}). Twilio proxy: Twilio Message resource { sid, status, to, from, body, ... }.

name: AgentPhone Number
description: Provision a real phone number for an AI agent over x402 (AgentPhone). Returns a number_id + phone number you can then use to send SMS/iMessage and place AI voice calls (those actions are separate AgentPhone services). First-party AgentPhone gateway on Base/Solana, keyless x402.

usage.callShape: POST https://api.agentphone.ai/x402/v1/numbers with JSON body {} (optionally {country, areaCode, agentId}). Provisions a real phone number.
usage.outputShape: body.{id (use as number_id), phoneNumber, country, status, type, agentId, createdAt}. Save id as the number_id for AgentPhone SMS/calls.
quirks: Re-verified 2026-06-10: POST with a minimal body provisions a real US SMS number ($0.01, 200). Returns id (number_id) + phoneNumber (e.g. +1...).
This creates a REAL, billable phone number — needsApproval true. Reuse the returned id (number_id) across SMS/call actions rather than provisioning repeatedly.
The x402 backend transparently proxies api.paysponge.com. Keyless x402 on Base (also Solana).
usage.guide: POST https://api.agentphone.ai/x402/v1/numbers with a JSON body {"country":"US"} (or {} for default) to provision a phone number. Keyless x402 (~$0.01 USDC on Base). The response JSON has id (the number_id) and phoneNumber — save the id to send SMS or place calls via the AgentPhone messaging/call services. This provisions a REAL number, so treat it as an approved, billable action.

name: AgentPhone Messaging & Calls
description: Phone infrastructure for AI agents over x402. Set up an AI agent (free), provision a real phone number ($0.01), then send SMS/iMessage messages ($0.02), place AI-driven outbound or in-browser voice calls (up to $0.50), and read inbound messages, call recordings and transcripts (wallet-scoped). Served via the first-party AgentPhone x402 gateway on Base/Solana. (The gateway exposes the callable action endpoints; account-management/usage/webhook routes from the full OpenAPI are not x402-exposed.)

usage.callShape: POST https://api.agentphone.ai/x402/v1/messages with WRAPPED body {"body":{to_number, body, from_number}} (the message text goes in the inner body.body string).
quirks: SCHEMA (discovered 2026-06-10): the x402 gateway wraps the message under a top-level key — send {"body":{"to_number":"+1...","body":"<text>","from_number":"<your provisioned number>"}}. A flat body, or body as {text}, returns 422 (charge-then-validate, ~$0.02 each).

PREREQUISITES (all FREE via x402): 1) provision a number (POST /x402/v1/numbers, $0.01); 2) create an agent with enableMessaging:true (POST /x402/v1/agents, $0, returns agent id); 3) attach the number (POST /x402/v1/agents/{agent_id}/numbers {numberId}, $0). The from_number must be attached to an agent, else send returns 400 'not assigned to any agent'.

HARD BLOCKER (verified 2026-06-10): outbound SMS returns 403 'Outbound SMS is not enabled for this account. Complete 10DLC registration first.' — 10DLC is US carrier A2P brand/campaign registration, an account-level compliance step done OUTSIDE x402 (manual, multi-day). Until completed for the AgentPhone account, outbound SMS cannot be sent via x402.

CALLS (/x402/v1/calls, /calls/web): ~$0.50, use the x402 permit2 'upto' dynamic scheme (not standard exact) and likely need similar voice-account setup — UNVERIFIED (not attempted, to avoid a $0.50 charge-then-error).
usage.guide: AgentPhone messaging/calls over x402. Flow: provision a number (POST /x402/v1/numbers, $0.01), create a messaging agent (POST /x402/v1/agents {name,enableMessaging:true}, free), attach the number (POST /x402/v1/agents/{agent_id}/numbers {numberId}, free), then send SMS via POST /x402/v1/messages with body {"body":{to_number,body,from_number}}. NOTE: outbound SMS is currently BLOCKED by 10DLC carrier registration (403, must be completed in the AgentPhone account, off-x402). Voice calls use a $0.50 permit2 scheme and are unverified.

name: Buy Phone Number
description: Provision a new US or CA phone number on a 30-day lease, usable as outbound caller ID for AI voice calls. Available via two gateways: BlockRun ($5, default) and StablePhone ($20). Returns the provisioned number and its expiry.

usage.callShape: POST JSON. BlockRun (default): {country:'US'|'CA' (default US), areaCode?:'3-digit string'}. StablePhone: {country_code:'US'|'CA' (default US), area_code?:'^\d{3}$'}. Both accept an empty body to default to a random US number.
usage.outputShape: success(bool true), phone_number(string, E.164 e.g. +1XXXXXXXXXX), expires_at(ISO timestamp 30 days out)
quirks: FIELD-NAME TRAP across gateways: BlockRun uses {country, areaCode} (camelCase areaCode); StablePhone uses {country_code, area_code} (snake_case area_code). Bodies are NOT interchangeable between backends.

Both backends set additionalProperties:false — extra keys (e.g. a 'type' key) 400 with 'Invalid request body' (unrecognized_keys) and do NOT charge, so bodies can be probed safely before the valid body triggers the charge.
country/country_code enum is US or CA only.
areaCode/area_code is best-effort: availability not guaranteed, omit to get any available number.
BlockRun also exposes /api/v1/phone/numbers/renew ($5) and /release ($0) for lease management; StablePhone uses /api/number/topup ($15) to extend (see the Top Up service).

VERIFIED via prior lease 2026-06-08 (MASTERKEY_ASSETS.md): leased +1 816 750 6853 ($5, 30-day lease, expires 2026-07-09) via blockrun.ai/api/v1/phone/numbers/buy. The $5 is a 30-day lease (recurring). Outward → needsApproval.
usage.guide: Provision a new US or CA phone number on a 30-day lease, usable as outbound caller ID for AI voice calls. Available via two gateways: BlockRun ($5, default) and StablePhone ($20). Returns the provisioned number and its expiry. POST JSON. BlockRun (default): {country:'US'|'CA' (default US), areaCode?:'3-digit string'}. StablePhone: {country_code:'US'|'CA' (default US), area_code?:'^\d{3}$'}. Both accept an empty body to default to a random US number. Output: success(bool true), phone_number(string, E.164 e.g. +1XXXXXXXXXX), expires_at(ISO timestamp 30 days out)

name: Top Up Phone Number
description: Extend an existing StablePhone phone number's lease by 30 days from its current expiry. Top-ups stack. Anyone can top up any number (no ownership check).

usage.callShape: POST JSON {phone_number} — REQUIRED, must match ^\+1\d{10}$ (E.164 US/CA, e.g. +15551234567).
usage.outputShape: success(bool true), phone_number(string), expires_at(ISO timestamp, +30 days from prior expiry)
quirks: Field is phone_number (snake_case) and is REQUIRED; pattern ^\+1\d{10}$ (must include the +1 prefix).
Top-ups STACK on the current expiry, not on 'now' — extends from existing expires_at.
Anyone can top up any number — no ownership/SIWX check on this endpoint.
additionalProperties:false: extra keys 400 without charging.
Different operation from buying a number — requires an ALREADY-provisioned number as input; not a way to acquire a new number.
Note: BlockRun's equivalent lease-extension is /api/v1/phone/numbers/renew at $5 (cheaper) — a candidate second gateway if/when its renew input schema is confirmed.

APPROVAL-GATED: this is an OUTWARD/irreversible action (real charge / order / shipment). Shape is from the provider OpenAPI/discovery and was NOT QA-executed (we do not place real bookings/purchases as tests). The needsApproval gate fires before any real execution.
usage.guide: Extend an existing StablePhone phone number's lease by 30 days from its current expiry. Top-ups stack. Anyone can top up any number (no ownership check). POST JSON {phone_number} — REQUIRED, must match ^\+1\d{10}$ (E.164 US/CA, e.g. +15551234567). Output: success(bool true), phone_number(string), expires_at(ISO timestamp, +30 days from prior expiry)

name: StablePhone iMessage/FaceTime Lookup
description: Check whether a phone number has iMessage/FaceTime, plus carrier and country. Async: pay → token → poll SIWX status. Pay-per-call x402 ($0.05), no API key.

usage.callShape: POST https://stablephone.dev/api/lookup with JSON body {phone_number} (E.164) → 202 {token}; then poll GET https://stablephone.dev/api/lookup/status?token=<jwt> with SIWX (paying wallet, free) until body.status=="complete"
usage.outputShape: Status poll body: body.status ("complete"), body.imessage, body.facetime (available|unavailable|unknown), body.carrier, body.country, body.checked_at. (POST response: body.token JWT)
quirks: Two-step async: paid POST /api/lookup returns HTTP 202 with {token} (a JWT), NOT the result. The actual result comes from the status endpoint.

Poll GET /api/lookup/status?token=<jwt> with SIWX auth (same paying wallet), which is FREE. In this run status was 'complete' on the first poll (~0s), but spec says it can take 30-90s — poll every 3-5s.
Token (JWT) expires after 60 min; iat/exp embedded. Re-querying the same number within ~1h reuses cached result (no extra charge).
imessage/facetime values are available|unavailable|unknown (unknown ~ landline/VoIP). For test number +14155551234 both returned 'unavailable' and carrier/country were null.
Status endpoint requires SIWX sign-in (paying wallet identity), not x402 payment — pass it as the SIWX-authed GET.
usage.guide: Check whether a phone number has iMessage/FaceTime plus carrier/country. POST https://stablephone.dev/api/lookup with {"phone_number":"+1..."} in E.164 — this pays $0.05 USDC on Base via x402 and returns HTTP 202 {token} (a JWT), not the answer. Then poll GET https://stablephone.dev/api/lookup/status?token=<jwt> using SIWX (the same paying wallet, free) every 3-5s until body.status=="complete" (typically 0-90s; the JWT is valid 60 min). Read body.imessage / body.facetime (available|unavailable|unknown) plus body.carrier and body.country.

name: Renew Phone Number Lease
description: Extend an existing wallet-owned number lease by 30 days.

usage.callShape: POST https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/phone/numbers/renew with body {phoneNumber} (E.164, must be a wallet-owned provisioned number) -> extends that number's lease by 30 days; returns a JSON result object synchronously.
quirks: OUTWARD/irreversible real-world effect: spends $5 to extend a real phone-number lease — needsApproval; do NOT pay-test casually.
phoneNumber must be in E.164 format (e.g. +15555550123) AND must be a number already provisioned/owned by the paying wallet; renewing a number you don't own will likely charge-then-error.
Fixed price $5.00 USDC on Base (amount 5000000 atomic, 6 decimals). No dynamic pricing.
Sync response (no job id to poll). 402 challenge carries accepts in both payment-required and www-authenticate (X402 v2) headers plus JSON body.
OUTWARD/irreversible — gated with needsApproval; not pay-tested in this batch.

name: Release Phone Number
description: Release a wallet-owned number back to the Twilio pool. Free, but still goes through x402 so the wallet identity is verified.

usage.callShape: POST https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/phone/numbers/release with body {phoneNumber} (E.164) -> releases the wallet-owned number back to the Twilio pool; returns a JSON result confirmation.
quirks: OUTWARD/IRREVERSIBLE: permanently releases a phone number the wallet owns back to Twilio's pool - do NOT pay-test casually, requires needsApproval
Price is $0 but the call STILL goes through x402 (returns HTTP 402 with amount '0') purely to verify wallet identity / ownership - a payment with a valid signature for amount 0 is required to proceed
phoneNumber must be in E.164 format (e.g. +14155550123) and must already be provisioned to the calling wallet
network is eip155:8453 (Base), asset is USDC (0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913)
Synchronous - returns a result object directly, no job id to poll
FREE endpoint — returns 200 on an unpaid request (no x402 charge).
OUTWARD/irreversible — gated with needsApproval; not pay-tested in this batch.

name: Phone Number Carrier Lookup
description: Look up carrier and line type (landline / mobile / VoIP) for any phone number via Twilio Lookup.

usage.callShape: POST https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/phone/lookup with body {phoneNumber} (E.164) -> returns carrier name + line type (landline/mobile/VoIP) via Twilio Lookup.
quirks: Pay-tested live 2026-06-24 ($0.01).
phoneNumber must be E.164 format (e.g. +14155552671)
Fixed price $0.01 USDC on Base (10000 atomic units), confirmed via live 402 accepts
Sync response (no job id to poll); just a read-only carrier lookup
402 body also echoes price as {amount:'0.0100',currency:'USD'}; accepts live in payment-required / x-payment-required / www-authenticate headers

name: Phone Number Fraud Lookup
description: Carrier + fraud signals (SIM swap, call forwarding) via Twilio Lookup. Useful for KYC and account-takeover defenses.

usage.callShape: POST https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/phone/lookup/fraud with body {phoneNumber} (E.164) -> returns carrier info + fraud signals (SIM-swap detection, call forwarding) via Twilio Lookup, sync JSON.
quirks: Pay-tested live 2026-06-24 ($0.05).
phoneNumber must be E.164 format (e.g. +14155552671)
Fixed price $0.05 (50000 atomic USDC) on Base eip155:8453
Sync response; no job id / polling
Read-only lookup (no outward effect), but it is a real Twilio Lookup query so use a real/valid number when pay-testing
Pay-test bills $0.05 regardless of result; verify a non-empty result is returned to avoid charge-then-empty

name: Wallet-Owned Phone Numbers
description: Return all active numbers leased to the calling wallet. Tiny x402 charge confirms wallet identity.

usage.callShape: POST https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/phone/numbers/list with empty JSON body {} (identity = paying wallet) -> returns the list of active phone numbers leased to the calling wallet.
quirks: Empty body: identity is derived from the x402 payment signature (calling wallet), not from any request param -- there is no way to query another wallet's numbers.
Wallet-scoped result: a wallet with no leased numbers returns an empty list (still charged the $0.001).
Fixed price $0.001 USDC on Base (atomic amount 1000, asset 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913, payTo 0xe9030014F5DAe217d0A152f02A043567b16c1aBf).
Sync: result returned directly in the 200 body, no job id to poll.
Charge-then-empty: the tiny fee is taken to confirm wallet identity even when there are zero numbers; do not treat empty result as a failure.
